messages:
marta: Kickoff: we need a fresh benchmark narrative that doesn't feel like "latency vs cost v2". Idea: call it the 'efficiency slab' 1 a simple band showing where customers get best ROI. Need hero + 2 supporting visuals + CTA routing. Draft deck Thu.

sam: 'Efficiency slab' works. It's more product-y and less academic. Recommend hero headline that ties to product outcome: 'Latency that scales. Costs that predict.'

alex: I'll run targeted microbenches (chat 128/256, embed 1k) across hosted/dedicated/int8. Will include median, p95, cost/1k, tokens/sec. Posting links when ready.

liv: Visual plan: hero scatter with shaded slab (band), inset fat-tail violin for median->p95, and a stacked bar showing per-token cost breakdown (model compute, infra, batching savings). Color blind palette.

noah: Inbound routing proposal: bench-request -> tag bench. If ARR > 50k -> AE. If "private" selected -> Enterprise + Security. If request selects 'dedicated' or > 5k qps -> Solutions Eng. Also add a checkbox for "I want a performance-first plan" to prioritize follow-up.

bench-bot: Bench complete: dataset microbench-2026-06. hosted: median 140ms p95 430ms cost/1k $0.15 tps 7k. dedicated: median 46ms p95 118ms cost/1k $0.072 tps 31k. int8: median 72ms p95 190ms cost/1k $0.048 tps 24k. CSV: /bench/microbench-2026-06/summary.csv

liv: Perfect. I'll produce a hero PNG with slab annotation + two small panels. Need p95 delta percentages for annotations (how much p95 improves from hosted -> dedicated/int8).

alex: p95 deltas: hosted->dedicated ~72% reduction, hosted->int8 ~56% reduction. Adding a small percent_delta column to the CSV now.

sam: Webinar hook: 1) explain slab concept with an animated slide showing movement along slab, 2) demo: run a microbench and interpret the slab for a sample product, 3) engineering levers + customer vignette, 4) CTA: free microbench + tailored routing. 20m + 10 Qs.

revops-bot: Suggested form fields: company, contact email, estimated monthly tokens, desired SLA (p50/p95), preferred deployment, estimated ARR. Auto-tag: bench-request. If ARR>50k, flag for AE.

marta: Action items: alex -> final CSV + percent deltas (EOD). liv -> PNG mocks (AM). noah -> RevOps routing doc. sam -> webinar slide flow + demo script. I'll assemble slide deck and loop back for quick review tomorrow. Thanks! :rocket:
